findings.fact: Selected full application signing case fails during the first Unpacker.withOwnedApplication baseline validation, before Vault creation, lease publication, resign or output reopen. Raw file-count trace records 5 complete verified Mach-Os then missingSpecialSlot(1); the selected case fails once after 47.817 seconds. No compiler error or timeout is this failure.

missingSpecialSlot(1) requires a nonzero expected CodeDirectory Info special-slot hash with neither supplied external nor embedded material. A missing expected Info slot is not the observed error. MachOSignatureReader returns nil for all external slots when component executable-path lookup is absent. For a matched component, Info materialFact throws on unreadable/missing Info instead of returning nil.

Producer metadata lists 5 signed framework bundles plus main/Share/Widget. Inventory code files are traversed lexically; after 5 Frameworks entries the first expected component is PlugIns/yuedu_app_ShareExtension.appex/yuedu_app_ShareExtension. Raw trace includes no failing executable path, so this attribution is an inference, not a binary-path observation.

Both explicit extension Info.plist inputs omit CFBundlePackageType; project extension configurations do not enable GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE. MaterialInventory.parseInfoPlist requires a string CFBundlePackageType and nonroot invalid metadata becomes an issue with nil executable mapping. Both extensions must describe XPC! roles; main generation is separately enabled, so absence in main source plist is not equivalent.

Original full producer accepted expected main/Share/Widget kinds without requiring APPL/XPC! or all MaterialInventory mandatory metadata. It signs whole bundles using codesign, deep strict Apple verification passed for all 8, and original Info bytes are protected by the unrelated-file preservation assertion. Candidate refuses invalid required metadata before any codesign, never fills or rewrites fixture metadata.

The retained artifact excludes the complete IPA and processed Info.plist/Mach-O bytes. Built extension CFBundlePackageType absence is not directly observed; builtin-infoPlistUtility output must be verified by the next actual SDK run. No new Apple build, signing or device validation has run.
